instruction: Create an S3 bucket with Pulumi (Python)
output: pulumi config set aws:region us-east-1 && cat > __main__.py << 'EOF' import pulumi_aws as aws; bucket = aws.s3.Bucket('my-bucket'); pulumi.export('bucket_name', bucket.id) EOF

instruction: Deploy the S3 bucket Python program
output: pulumi up -y

instruction: Create a VPC with subnets in Pulumi
output: echo 'from pulumi_aws import ec2; vpc = ec2.Vpc("main", cidr_block="10.0.0.0/16"); subnet = ec2.Subnet("public", vpc_id=vpc.id, cidr_block="10.0.1.0/24")' > __main__.py

instruction: Create an EC2 instance in Pulumi using AMI lookup
output: echo 'import pulumi_aws as aws; ami = aws.ec2.get_ami(most_recent=True, filters=[{"name":"name","values":["ubuntu-*22.04*"]}]); instance = aws.ec2.Instance("web", ami=ami.id, instance_type="t3.micro")' > __main__.py

instruction: Create a security group with ingress rules
output: echo 'sg = aws.ec2.SecurityGroup("web", ingress=[{"protocol":"tcp","from_port":80,"to_port":80,"cidr_blocks":["0.0.0.0/0"]}])' > sg.py

instruction: Create an RDS instance with Pulumi
output: echo 'db = aws.rds.Instance("main", engine="postgres", engine_version="16", instance_class="db.t3.micro", allocated_storage=20, db_name="myapp", username="admin", password="secret123")' > __main__.py

instruction: Create a Lambda function with Pulumi
output: echo 'fn = aws.lambda_.Function("fn", role=iam_role.arn, handler="index.handler", runtime="python3.12", filename="lambda.zip")' > __main__.py

instruction: Create an ECS Fargate service with Pulumi
output: echo 'cluster = aws.ecs.Cluster("main"); task_def = aws.ecs.TaskDefinition("app", family="app", network_mode="awsvpc", requires_compatibilities=["FARGATE"], cpu="256", memory="512", container_definitions=json.dumps([{"name":"app","image":"nginx:latest"}])); service = aws.ecs.Service("svc", cluster=cluster.arn, task_definition=task_def.arn, desired_count=2, launch_type="FARGATE")' > __main__.py

instruction: Create an EKS cluster with Pulumi
output: echo 'cluster = aws.eks.Cluster("main", role_arn=aws.iam.Role("eks", assume_role_policy=json.dumps({"Version":"2012-10-17","Statement":[{"Effect":"Allow","Principal":{"Service":"eks.amazonaws.com"},"Action":"sts:AssumeRole"}]})).arn); aws.eks.NodeGroup("nodes", cluster_name=cluster.name, node_role_arn=aws.iam.Role("node", assume_role_policy=json.dumps({"Version":"2012-10-17","Statement":[{"Effect":"Allow","Principal":{"Service":"ec2.amazonaws.com"},"Action":"sts:AssumeRole"}]})).arn, scaling_config={"desired_size":3,"max_size":10,"min_size":2})' > eks.py

instruction: Create a Route53 DNS record with Pulumi
output: echo 'record = aws.route53.Record("www", zone_id="Z123456", name="www.example.com", type="A", ttl=300, records=["203.0.113.1"])' > __main__.py

instruction: Export output values in Pulumi
output: echo 'pulumi.export("instance_ip", instance.public_ip); pulumi.export("bucket_arn", bucket.arn)' > __main__.py

instruction: Use pulumi.interpolate for string formatting
output: echo 'url = pulumi.Output.concat("https://", lb.dns_name)' > __main__.py

instruction: Use apply() to transform Pulumi outputs
output: echo 'instance_id = instance.id.apply(lambda id: f"ec2-{id}")' > __main__.py

instruction: Use pulumi.Config to read configuration
output: echo 'config = pulumi.Config(); env = config.require("environment"); region = config.get("region", "us-east-1")' > config_example.py

instruction: Use pulumi.Config.require_secret for sensitive config
output: echo 'config = pulumi.Config(); db_pass = config.require_secret("db_password")' > config_example.py

instruction: Use StackReference to get another stack's outputs
output: echo 'infra = pulumi.StackReference("infra/prod"); vpc_id = infra.require_output("vpc_id")' > __main__.py

instruction: Use pulumi.ResourceOptions for depends_on
output: echo 'instance = aws.ec2.Instance("web", opts=pulumi.ResourceOptions(depends_on=[sg]))' > __main__.py

instruction: Use pulumi.ResourceOptions with protect
output: echo 'db = aws.rds.Instance("main", opts=pulumi.ResourceOptions(protect=True))' > __main__.py

instruction: Use pulumi.ResourceOptions import to adopt resources
output: echo 'bucket = aws.s3.Bucket("existing", opts=pulumi.ResourceOptions(import="existing-bucket-name"))' > __main__.py

instruction: Use pulumi.ResourceOptions for deleteBeforeReplace
output: echo 'instance = aws.ec2.Instance("web", opts=pulumi.ResourceOptions(delete_before_replace=True))' > __main__.py

instruction: Use pulumi.ResourceOptions for aliases (rename migration)
output: echo 'service = aws.ecs.Service("app-svc", opts=pulumi.ResourceOptions(aliases=["old-alias-urn"]))' > __main__.py

instruction: Create a Pulumi component resource class
output: echo 'class WebServer(pulumi.ComponentResource): def __init__(self, name, opts=None): super().__init__("my:component:WebServer", name, None, opts)' > components.py

instruction: Add resources inside a component resource
output: echo 'class WebServer(pulumi.ComponentResource): def __init__(self, name, opts=None): super().__init__("my:component:WebServer", name, None, opts); self.instance = aws.ec2.Instance(f"{name}-ec2", opts=pulumi.ResourceOptions(parent=self))' > components.py

instruction: Export outputs from a component
output: echo 'class WebServer(pulumi.ComponentResource): def __init__(self): super().__init__("my:ws", "web", None); self.register_outputs({"ip": self.instance.public_ip})' > components.py

instruction: Create a Pulumi dynamic provider for custom resources
output: echo 'from pulumi.dynamic import Resource, ResourceProvider; class MyProvider(ResourceProvider): def create(self, props): return {"id": "1", "outs": {"result": props["input"]}}; class MyResource(Resource): def __init__(self, name, input, opts=None): super().__init__(MyProvider(), name, {"input": input}, opts)' > dynamic.py
